messages:
Maya (CEO): Thanks everyone for joining today's all-hands. Quick follow-up thread for Q&A we ran out of time on. I'll collect notes, links, and owners here.

Jordan (VP Eng): Can we confirm Dedicated GA date? Heard 'end of Q2' but need a hard day for planning.

Maya (CEO): Targeting June 28 for GA, internal beta mid-May. Keeping buffer for final perf tuning. Not final if a major blocker appears.

Priya (Product): Any change to reserved capacity pricing or tiers for GA customers?

Maya (CEO): No pricing change planned for GA — finance will validate numbers next week. If anything shifts we'll announce with 2 weeks' lead.

Samir (Security): For Private deployments, what exactly is needed for the compliance checklist? Team asks about SOC2 scoping.

Lina (Eng Manager): SOC2 + infra pen test. Ops has a template. ops-bot, can you post the checklist link?

ops-bot: Checklist uploaded: https://internal.redwood/docs/compliance/private-deploy-checklist — requires completion of infra diagram, data flow, KMS config, and pen test scheduling. :page_facing_up:

Jordan (VP Eng): Also flagged: rollout policy for model fallback. We need a canary plan doc.

Maya (CEO): Good call. Action: Jordan to own canary rollout playbook. Priya to own comms to customers. Lina to run one dry-run with Dedicated infra.

Priya (Product): I'll draft the comms and share in #product by Wed 5/10. Owner: Priya. Due: 2025-05-10.

Jordan (VP Eng): I'll put the canary playbook PR up by 2025-05-12 and tag Eng SRE for review.

Lina (Eng Manager): Dry-run scheduled for 2025-05-20. I'll invite Eng/SRE/Support.

Maya (CEO): Office hours to go over these: Thursday 3pm PT. Bring blockers. :calendar:

Samir (Security): Request: Can we get a concise bullet list of what's expected to sign off SOC2 for Private? Prefer a 1-page checklist.

Lina (Eng Manager): Will produce 1-pager. Owner: Lina. Due: 2025-05-07.

Maya (CEO): TL;DR action list:
- Jordan: Canary rollout playbook PR — due 2025-05-12
- Priya: Customer comms draft — due 2025-05-10
- Lina: SOC2 1-pager + dry-run coordination — due 2025-05-07 and 2025-05-20
- Finance: confirm GA pricing impact — due 2025-05-09

Jordan (VP Eng): Adding: Perf SRE to verify KV cache gains before GA. @Samir we might need security acceptance criteria in the playbook.

Samir (Security): Agreed. I'll add criteria to the SOC2 1-pager and give a thumbs up or list blockers.

Priya (Product): Linking notes from today's slides: https://internal.redwood/slides/all-hands-2025-04

Maya (CEO): Thanks all. If you hit blockers ping me directly. Closing thread for updates — please update the issues instead of replying in this thread so we can track owners.

Lina (Eng Manager): Noted. I'll create JIRA tickets and link back here.

Jordan (VP Eng): Will do. :rocket:
